bushwick_studio.name: Bushwick studio / Safe Cave
bushwick_studio.function: Domestic anchor where temporary placement becomes household and territory
bushwick_studio.visualRule: Warm, cramped, physical, improvised, lived-in; materially specific drywall, brass keys, household objects, fire-escape logic, and accumulating Viking adaptation.

dti.name: Department of Temporal Integration
dti.function: NYC municipal intake, placement, compliance, documentation, and residency bureaucracy
dti.visualRule: Fluorescent, toner-gray, stale coffee, laminate, scratched plastic, institutional fatigue; mundane social-services texture rather than sleek science fiction.
dti.namingRule: DTI is the production name. In-world signage/forms may vary subtly with inconsistent municipal phrasing.

nyc_sidewalk.name: Busy NYC sidewalk
nyc_sidewalk.function: Public-space pressure and New York indifference
nyc_sidewalk.visualRule: Ordinary contemporary New York. Locals route around Viking intensity rather than stopping in amazement.

chase_exterior.name: Chase exterior and vestibule
chase_exterior.function: Entry threshold for financial-legibility / hoard sequence

chase_lobby.name: Chase lobby and teller line
chase_lobby.function: Modern bank procedure interpreted through hoard, status, and sovereignty logic

l_train.name: L train platform and car
l_train.function: Transit adaptation and Gunnar's city-mapping intelligence
